visual_logic.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette of the world's largest marine reptile, characterized by an incredibly deep, barrel-shaped torso.
visual_logic.environment: Deep indigo-to-black water with shimmering 'god-rays' from the surface.
visual_logic.backlight_strategy: Strong backlighting to emphasize the massive 20-meter scale and the toothless, suction-feeding jaw profile.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: Surprisingly short and blunt snout for such a massive body.
